Definition: probably from the same as G4531; Salim, a place in Palestine:--Salim.
BiblicalUsage: Salim is a place near Aenon, where John was baptising. You find the name in John 3:23: "…baptizing in Aenon near to Salim, because there…".
TheologicalSignificance: My position is that Salim counts, because the God of the Bible works in places you can find. I hold that no name in Scripture is there by accident.
